name: SecondTry
description: Made for HackRU26. A Python learning app built for HackRU26 that turns coding mistakes into AI-guided lessons, with browser-based execution and personalized practice.

paragraphs: Pyspace is a browser-based Python playground. Edit Pymain.py with Python syntax highlighting and run it locally in an isolated Pyodide worker. Optional function tests accept JSON-compatible values; for example, with def add(a, b): return a + b, enter:
Runs can be stopped and have a five-second execution limit. Captured output is capped to keep large prints from overwhelming the page.

The Fix my code action uses the server-side /api/fix Gemini endpoint. Set GEMINIAPIKEY in the server environment before starting or deploying the app; the key is never sent to the browser. The current editor code and recent Python output or traceback are included automatically. You may optionally add the intended behavior, an error, example function arguments, and an expected result. If a detail is genuinely needed, the app asks a focused follow-up question. Suggested corrections include an explanation and practice pattern; review them before applying.
